description: The union of an increasing sequence of finite partial isomorphisms whose domains cover \(M\) and whose ranges cover \(N\) is an isomorphism from \(M\) onto \(N\), extending every map in the sequence.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BackAndForth.FinitePartialIso.chain_isomorphism.{u, v, w, w'} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  {M : Type w} {N : Type w'} [L.Structure M] [L.Structure N]
  (p : ℕ → Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BackAndForth.FinitePartialIso L M N) (hp : Monotone p)
  (hdom : ∀ (a : M), ∃ n, a ∈ (p n).dom) (hran : ∀ (b : N), ∃ n a, (p n).toFun a = b) :
  ∃ e, ∀ (n : ℕ) (a : ↑(p n).dom), e ↑a = (p n).toFun a
